tokens.purpose: Default light-theme canvas for brand-facing pages.
tokens.notes: Preserve the current value during replacement; palette remapping changes the warmth of a large surface.

tokens.purpose: Raised cards, panels, forms, and navigation surfaces on a light canvas.
tokens.notes: Page and surface may initially share a hue; elevation must remain legible through border and shadow tokens.

tokens.purpose: Quiet secondary panels, chips, and grouped content.
tokens.notes: Use a documented alpha or derived tint in implementation rather than inventing another raw cream.

tokens.purpose: Dark brand bands, hero panels, sidebars, and dark-theme canvas.
tokens.notes: Validate gradients and dark-theme elevation after mapping away from the current blue ink.

tokens.purpose: Deepest dark layer used to distinguish nested inverse surfaces.
tokens.notes: Do not use interchangeably with the page inverse token without checking layer separation.

tokens.purpose: Primary body text and headings on light surfaces.
tokens.notes: Proposed text on Paper has approximately 13.46:1 contrast.

tokens.purpose: Supporting copy and metadata that remains comfortably readable.
tokens.notes: Implementation may derive a controlled opacity from Text Dark; verify contrast over translucent surfaces.

tokens.purpose: De-emphasized labels, captions, and tertiary metadata.
tokens.notes: Define opacity only after checking WCAG contrast; muted must not mean illegible.

tokens.purpose: Primary text on inverse and dark surfaces.
tokens.notes: Paper on Ink/Night has approximately 16.98:1 contrast.

tokens.purpose: Canonical interactive and identifying ARTales gold.
tokens.notes: Gold is an accent, not default small text on Paper.

tokens.purpose: Alternate approved gold for controlled brand compositions.
tokens.notes: Keep distinct only where brand guidance needs it; avoid near-duplicate use in ordinary UI.

tokens.purpose: Hover and pressed emphasis for gold actions.
tokens.notes: Pair with Ink/Night or Text Dark, not Paper text, and test hover distinction.

tokens.purpose: Subtle gold fills and decorative accents.
tokens.notes: Implement as a controlled tint/alpha for fills; solid Gold Shade on Paper is not suitable for small text.

tokens.purpose: Locked symbol color where the approved brand asset or its exact UI analogue is required.
tokens.notes: Do not recolor brand masters or exports; this token does not supersede locked asset rules.

tokens.purpose: Low-emphasis separators and card outlines.
tokens.notes: Use a centrally defined alpha; the proposal value is the opaque source color, not a recommendation for a solid border.

tokens.purpose: Emphasized controls, selected panels, and structural boundaries.
tokens.notes: Check adjacent fill and focus-ring distinction.

tokens.purpose: Background of the main action in a view.
tokens.notes: This intentionally changes action hierarchy in Phase 3; defer until component states and contrast are reviewed.

tokens.purpose: Label and icon color on the primary action.
tokens.notes: Ink/Night on Primary Gold has approximately 8.90:1 contrast; current white must not remain when the background becomes gold.

tokens.purpose: Hover/pressed background for the primary action.
tokens.notes: Validate keyboard, hover, active, disabled, and loading states as one state set.

tokens.purpose: Background of secondary and quiet actions.
tokens.notes: Must remain distinct from the containing surface through the secondary border token.

tokens.purpose: Label and icon color on secondary actions.
tokens.notes: Strong contrast on Paper; continue to show state without relying on color alone.

tokens.purpose: Long-form reading paper in the default reader theme.
tokens.notes: Reader offers multiple independent themes; preserve all current values until dedicated readability QA.

tokens.purpose: Long-form body text on reader paper.
tokens.notes: Test long-session comfort, font weights, links, annotations, and each reader theme.

tokens.purpose: Reader metadata, captions, and non-primary controls.
tokens.notes: A controlled opacity may be suitable but must be tested independently in every reader theme.

tokens.purpose: Text selection and reader-local highlight.
tokens.notes: Use a translucent derived value and verify selected text contrast in all themes.

tokens.purpose: Keyboard focus indicator across themes and components.
tokens.notes: Focus must remain visible against both Paper and Ink/Night; consider an offset/contrast halo rather than color alone.

tokens.purpose: Successful completion, owned/access-granted status, and confirmations.
tokens.source: Current UI fallback; no approved brand-palette semantic equivalent
tokens.notes: Retain a conventional non-brand state color and pair it with text/icon semantics.

tokens.purpose: Pending, caution, and attention-required states.
tokens.source: Current UI fallback; no approved brand-palette semantic equivalent
tokens.notes: Keep warning semantically distinct from decorative brand gold and never communicate status by color alone.

tokens.purpose: Errors, destructive actions, and blocked states.
tokens.source: Current UI fallback; no approved brand-palette semantic equivalent
tokens.notes: Preserve conventional meaning; separately define text, border, and subtle fill variants during implementation.

tokens.purpose: Neutral informational notices and in-progress guidance.
tokens.source: Current UI fallback; no approved brand-palette semantic equivalent
tokens.notes: Do not force all semantic states into the gold brand ramp.

migration_phases: replace hardcoded values preserving current visuals
map public-facing tokens to ARTales palette
